hypothesis: Cumulative native site-state weight programming initialized from measured KRAS single mutations and updated with a one-pass pair-residual write predicts unseen multi-mutants more accurately than a fully fitted same-information pairwise ridge predictor, without changing previously learned single-mutant weights.

source.license_caveat: MIT for code; underlying original assay-data redistribution terms not independently proven; do not copy original CSV into Yggdrasil
source.source_usage: Exact pinned original author-provided public historical KRAS binding assays, not a virgin novel physical world; GitHub file headers and repository directory listing known before this prereg, no original numeric outcomes read.
predecessors: WSP-193 INVALID due frozen 1500 source-genotype threshold, untouched
forbidden: mutated_sequence-based supervised embedding from pretrained language models
any held target or fitness in normalization
re-score WSP192 or WSP193 held outcomes
cross-assay label sharing without baseline parity

preprocessing.source_byte_custody: Verify exact Git blob SHA1, byte count, UTF-8, CSV header and row structural parse before numeric fits. Source only via read-only public GitHub author commit.
preprocessing.genotype: Infer per-position reference sequence as majority amino-acid identity across only the single-mutation source's sequences, without reading assay values. Encode each mutant as a sorted set of changed position:observed-amino-acid features. Assays get identical feature vocabulary and variant splits.
preprocessing.independence: Canonical complete mutant feature set forms a group; full genotype identical across source files is forbidden (no test leakage). Whole-genotype SHA256('WSP194-KRAS-v1'+NUL+features) first 8 bytes modulo 100: FIT 0..69; VALID 70..84; DEV 85..99. No reseed or balancing.
preprocessing.filtering: Discard any unmeasured assay value only for that assay. No unknown sequence characters, duplicate genotypes, mixed sequence lengths, or more than 5% excluded malformed structural rows. Do not select rows based on effect size.
preprocessing.minimums: Require >=50 distinct FIT measured single mutants in each attempted assay, >=1000 FIT multi-mutants and >=150 VALID and >=150 DEV multi-mutants in at least 3 assays; otherwise classified INVALID, no threshold change.
preprocessing.normalization: Per assay standardize by FIT-only single-mutant mean and population SD. All controls see identical normalization, source single and multi labels, same features and same split; no other assay outcomes shared.

design.learning: Stage 1 memorize/program persistent mutation weights from FIT single-mutant measured normalized effects using ridge shrink λ=[0.01,0.1,1] chosen by VALID singles. Stage 2 freeze singles and optionally apply one-pass FIT multi pair-residual direct writes.
design.direct_candidate: From each FIT multi-mutant residual y - sum(single mutation weights), write to each pair-feature a local residual average with denominator support_count+penalty; use direct interaction coefficient beta * sum(pair weights), beta=[-1,0,0.5,1,2], penalty=[1,10] selected by VALID multi-mutant RMSE.
design.strong_control: Converged coordinate-descent pairwise ridge regression on the exact same FIT multi-mutant residuals and SAME observed pair feature dictionary, regularization λ=[0.1,1,10], 250 sweeps maximum and convergence <=1e-4. Select strongest mean/additive/pairwise on VALID multi-mutants.
negative_controls: fixed seeded shuffle of FIT residual labels across genotypes before one-pass direct pair writes
design.validation: Select candidate beta/penalty and conventional ridge λ by VALID only; fixed tie rules prefer zero beta and larger regularization.
design.held_eval: Single DEV multi-mutant per-assay RMSE against strongest VALID-selected converged conventional, before/after single-mutant retention RMSE and 1000 pair-genotype-level bootstrap resamples for CI, six assays reported independently.
design.support_rule: Public development support only if >=4 assays available and at least 4/6 show >=5% lower held multi-genotype RMSE and bootstrap lower gain >0, with no >3% regression for any admitted assay and zero single-mutant retained weight drift. No independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS from public data.
design.negative_rule: If admitted data and qualified controls but primary held gain threshold fails, mark PUBLIC_DEV_NO_GO. Do not repick controls, salt, variants, lambdas or experimental family after outcomes.
design.invalid_rule: Missing/malformed source bytes, insufficient FIT/VALID/DEV, uncontrolled leakage, missing necessary convergence, or inability to fetch complete original files: INVALID/UNVERIFIED; do not treat as scientific result.
design.resource_budget: Original source max 5.5MB + 1MB, six independent assay computations, at most 250 ridge coordinate sweeps per lambda, 1000 bootstrap samples/assay; zero paid APIs and no GPU/runner dispatch.
design.capacity: Candidate and pairwise ridge share identical set of mutation-pair coordinates, with one extra global candidate beta/penalty; report stored parameters per assay and whole process time separately from source acquisition.
design.science_limit: This tests public retrospective within-KRAS variant generalization and trivial structural cold retention of frozen weights, not a new intervention action, unfamiliar-world transfer, causal discovery, or native Yggdrasil trained model.

primary_result_policy: One first primary DEV score (if admitted) after this commit and frozen evaluator/test code; preserve NEGATIVE or INVALID. No post-result tuning.
